Legacy PAs bought before 1 March 2026 instead follow an 8-trading-day cycle with 5 qualifying profit days required.

faqs.question: What is Apex Trader Funding?
faqs.answer: Apex Trader Funding is a futures-focused proprietary trading firm founded in 2021 by Darrell Martin and headquartered in Austin, Texas. Traders pass an End-of-Day or Intraday evaluation to receive a simulated Performance Account (PA) from $25,000 to $300,000 and can hold up to 20 PAs at once, trading futures markets only (no forex or CFDs).

faqs.question: What is the Apex Trader Funding profit split?
faqs.answer: Apex pays 100% of the first $25,000 in cumulative approved payouts per Performance Account, then 90% to the trader / 10% to Apex after that threshold. This tiered split has stayed unchanged through the March 2026 rules overhaul, even though the payout cycle and consistency requirements around it were revised.

seo.title: Apex Trader Funding Profit Split: 100% then 90% | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Apex Trader Funding pays 100% of the first $25,000 in payouts per account, then a 90/10 split for everything after that.

faqs.question: How often can I request a payout from Apex Trader Funding?
faqs.answer: As of the March 2026 rules update, current Performance Accounts can request a payout as often as weekly once 5 qualifying trading days have passed. Legacy PAs purchased before 1 March 2026 keep the original 8-trading-day cycle. Every PA is limited to 6 total payouts on a rising cap ladder, after which the account closes and a new evaluation is required.

seo.title: Apex Trader Funding Payout Cycle and 6-Payout Ladder | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Apex allows weekly payouts after 5 qualifying trading days, capped at 6 payouts per Performance Account on a rising ladder.

faqs.question: Which withdrawal methods does Apex Trader Funding support, and are there fees?
faqs.answer: US-based traders are paid via ACH, typically settling within 24–48 hours with no Apex-side fee. International traders are paid through Plane, which takes roughly 5–11 business days and may carry a processing fee. Every payout requires a $500 minimum and must keep the Safety Net (drawdown limit plus $100) intact in the account.

seo.title: Apex Trader Funding Withdrawal Methods and Fees | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Apex pays US traders via free ACH transfer and international traders via Plane, with a $500 minimum payout either way.

faqs.question: Does Apex Trader Funding have a balance-scaling plan?
faqs.answer: No. Instead of growing a single account's balance over time, Apex lets traders hold up to 20 active Performance Accounts simultaneously across EOD, Intraday and Legacy types. Each PA runs a fixed 6-payout ladder with caps that rise per request, then closes once the 6th payout is processed, at which point a new evaluation is needed to open another PA. There is also no refundable one-time challenge fee — PAs run on a recurring activation/subscription model instead.
